integrity: Exact integer incidence computations and complete finite S6 enumerations are reproducible, with a separate mathematical proof of the infinite finite-field assertion.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic greater than three; reduced fifteen-line boundary and its coordinate-S6 forms only. Integral torus decomposition established for five-cycle forms. Historical priority remains provisional; no independent scientific audit.
title: Finite-field twists and integral Picard tori of the fifteen-line Igusa boundary
